trigger.raw: Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part

skill2: Storage: Stores excess healing received by the skill user, up to 5.36% of their Max HP. Stacks up to 5 time(s) and lasts for 15 sec.

caveats: ⛑ skill2's ATK ▲ 23.74% (casterAtkPct, all allies, 15s) is her ONLY damage-relevant line and its literal activation clause is 'an ally or self destroys an enemy's part'. The scope-lock boss is PARTLESS, so on the graded fight this trigger never fires and the buff is INERT — authored as an `unsupported` trigger rather than re-keyed to a firing trigger, because re-keying would fabricate uptime the kit does not grant. If a real fight shows the buff live, re-key per the recipe in flags.
⛑ skill1 Outgoing healing ▲ 35.2% has no StatKey and no consumer (heals carry no HP amount in v1); it is a magnitude scaler on an unmodeled quantity, so it is unmodeled rather than inert-but-present.

⛑ The burst heal amount (52.27% of caster final Max HP) is recorded in prose only — the `heal` effect models the RECOVERY EVENT, not an HP amount, which is what teammates' `recovery` triggers consume. Tandem value is entirely via those consumers.
⛑ Burst trigger keyed `burstCast` (this is her OWN burst block, Burst I, cd 40s) — the heal lands at cast, pre-Full-Burst, per the burst-cast timing rule.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⛑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Sora (RL/Wind/Supporter/Burst I) is a HEAL-SIDE support: S1 scales her own outgoing healing, S2 converts a part-destruction event into a team ATK ▲ 23.74% of her ATK for 15s plus an excess-healing storage pool, and her burst is a full-team heal + 1 debuff cleanse. Modeled today: the S2 team ATK grant (casterAtkPct, all allies, 15s) and the burst team heal as a recovery-event emitter that fires allies' `recovery` triggers. The S2 grant's kit trigger is part-destruction, which has no engine primitive and cannot fire on the partless scope-lock boss, so the block carries an `unsupported` trigger and is inert at scope — faithful to the kit rather than re-keyed to make it live. Deliberately unmodeled: outgoing-healing magnitude (no consumer for a heal amount), the excess-healing Storage pool (no HP pool), and debuff removal (no ally debuff pool).

audit.kitLine: Activates at start of battle. Self.
audit.effectOrReason: Trigger/target classification only: passive + self. Carries no surviving effect (see next row), so no block is emitted — skill1 is a genuinely effect-free slot at v1 scope.

No `outgoingHealingPct` StatKey in types.ts, and the `heal` effect models no HP amount (v1 has no HP pool / immortal boss), so there is nothing for a healing-magnitude multiplier to scale. Not a heal/shield/DEF/HP/lifesteal SKIP-on-isolation violation: the underlying HEAL lines ARE modeled (burst) — only the unrepresentable MAGNITUDE scaler is dropped. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

audit.kitLine: Activates when ally/self destroys a part
audit.effectOrReason: Trigger encoded `{kind:'unsupported', raw:...}` — no part-destruction TriggerDef exists and the scope-lock boss is partless, so the activation clause is unfirable at v1. Read LITERALLY per HARD RULE 3 rather than re-keyed to fullBurstEnter/burstCast, which would over-credit uptime the kit never grants. ⛑ flagged with a re-key recipe.

An excess-healing accumulator (5 stacks, 15s) storing a fraction of Max HP. No primitive represents stored healing, and with no HP pool there is no 'excess' to capture; a `resource` pool would have no consumer since the kit states no conversion from Storage to damage. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

buff casterAtkPct 23.74, durationSec 15, target allies (kit says 'Affects all allies' — includes self, so no excludeSelf). 'of the skill user's ATK' is the literal casterAtkPct signature (flat add off HER ATK), NOT atkPct. Gated behind the unfirable part-destruction trigger above.

heal (ticks 1 — one instant recovery, not a HoT: no 'every 1 sec' clause), trigger burstCast, target allies. Per HARD RULE 4 (tandem/cross-unit) heals are NEVER skipped on isolation: this fires teammates' `recovery` triggers (Crown-style on-recovery damage buffs). The 52.27% magnitude is unrepresentable (no HP pool) and is recorded in caveats.
No ally debuff pool in v1 (the boss deals no damage and applies no ally debuffs at scope lock), so cleansing has no target state to act on. Verbatim in unmodeled.burst.

flags.estimate: {kind:'unsupported', raw:"Activates when an ally or self destroys an enemy's part"} — INERT at scope lock. Next-most-likely firing alternative if a real fight shows the buff live: {kind:'fullBurstEnter'} (broad, over-credits) or {kind:'burstCast'} (narrow, own-burst only).
flags.reasoning: The kit gives a literal activation clause with no engine primitive: there is no part-destruction TriggerDef, and the scope-lock boss is verified PARTLESS, so on the graded fight the condition is never satisfied by ANY ally. This makes the unit's sole damage-relevant line inert. Encoding it as `unsupported` is the faithful read (measured > fudge): choosing a firing trigger instead would invent uptime and inflate every teammate's ATK for a window the kit never opens. Because Sora is Burst I with cd 40s, a burstCast re-key would give roughly one 15s window per ~40s rotation (~37% uptime) while fullBurstEnter would fire on every team Full Burst regardless of whether she cast — these differ by a large factor, so guessing between them unmeasured would be a precise-guess error.
flags.recipe: Record a scope-lock fight with Sora slotted alongside a teammate whose damage is well-pinned, and read that teammate's popup values for a flat ATK step of 23.74% × Sora's static ATK. If NO step appears, the inert model is confirmed — leave the `unsupported` trigger in place. If a step DOES appear, time its onsets against the rotation log: onsets only on rotations Sora bursts → re-key `burstCast`; onsets on every Full Burst → `fullBurstEnter`; onsets on neither cadence → an interval/internal-CD trigger, fit sec from the onset spacing. Separately, on a boss WITH destructible parts, confirm whether the buff tracks part-destruction events.

flags.reasoning: Kit says 'Affects all allies' with no '(except self)' clause, so excludeSelf is omitted per the schema's stated convention. Low uncertainty — flagged only because the buff's own liveness is unresolved, which makes the target set untestable at scope lock.
flags.recipe: Falls out of the same recording as the trigger flag: if a step appears, check whether Sora's OWN popups also step by 23.74% × her ATK.

flags.estimate: {kind:'heal', ticks:1} — one instant recovery event per burst cast, no HP amount.
flags.reasoning: The line has no 'every 1 sec for N sec' wording, so it is a single instant recovery, not a HoT (ticks>1 would emit repeated recovery events and over-refresh an on-recovery consumer). The 52.27%-of-final-Max-HP magnitude is unmodelable — the engine's `heal` carries no amount by design — so Sora's entire tandem value routes through teammates' `recovery` triggers, where only the EVENT COUNT matters. Her damage contribution is therefore fully determined by (a) how many recovery events she emits and (b) whether a heal-consumer teammate is present.
flags.recipe: Run a comp pairing Sora with an on-recovery consumer and count that consumer's proc popups against Sora's burst casts in the rotation log — 1:1 confirms ticks:1; a burst of several procs per cast indicates a HoT and sets ticks from the proc count.

flags.reasoning: This is her own burst block (Burst I, cd 40s) with no separate activation clause, so it resolves at her cast. Per the trigger-identity rule a burst cast lands BEFORE the Full Burst window opens — relevant because a `recovery` consumer buffed at cast time then has its window running through the FB, rather than starting at FB entry.
flags.recipe: Rotation log: confirm the recovery event's frame precedes the fullBurstStart event on the same rotation.

flags.reasoning: Her only S1 line is a healing-magnitude scaler with no representable consumer. Emitting an empty array is correct per the authoring rule (empty only for a genuinely effect-free slot) rather than inventing a placeholder buff. If a future engine models heal AMOUNTS (an HP pool, or an ally scaler keyed off healing received), this line becomes live and should be revisited together with the skill2 Storage pool — both depend on the same missing subsystem.
flags.recipe: No fight measurement can resolve this at v1 — it is engine-capability-gated, not measurement-gated. Revisit if/when heal magnitudes are modeled.

flags.estimate: noFb NOT set (default OFF, FB-by-timing ON). No cadence tuple authored — base RL stats (ammo 6, reloadFrames 141, chargeFrames 60) left to the datamine.
flags.reasoning: Sora carries no function-damage effects at all (no flatDamage/dot/hitRepeat/storedHit), so noFb has nothing to apply to and must not be set unmeasured. Likewise no kit line modifies her weapon state (no reload/ammo/fire-rate/charge-speed/swap line), so there is no cadence override to author — the datamined RL values stand as-is. Flagged for completeness per the ALWAYS-⛑ taxonomy: reloadFrames/chargeFrames come from a known-unreliable datamine field, so her own chip damage carries that uncertainty even though no override value depends on it.
flags.recipe: Her personal damage is a pure base-weapon read: a solo-ish scope-lock recording scored against sim total damage would validate the RL cadence, but nothing in this override depends on it.
